answer: In this PoA design, each interaction contributes to a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust graph, while reputation decays according to an exponential temporal half-life. An identity must therefore sustain mutually validated honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted paths, it cannot exploit transitivity, accumulate authority, or pass consensus. It may wander a canyon, but cannot cross the ledge into legitimacy.
